Sage | Engineering & Product | Hybrid (2 days remote, 3 days in New York City/NYC area) | Full-Time | https://www.sagehealth.com

We're building hardware & software systems to improve elder care, and we're used by thousands across the US. Want to know that your work is directly improving people's lives? Come talk to us. https://www.sagehealth.com/company/careers

> Tech Lead/Manager, Native - to be posted; for our mobile native app strategy

Keep an eye on our Careers page, and feel free to reach out to alisa [at] sagehealth dot com with questions.
